name: message-hero
description: Centred message page: an illustration, a big status code, the heading, a line of copy and a row of buttons and links, over the soft colour wash. Built for the branded 404 template (live /404-not-found/: 'Oops…Page Not Found!').

image.description: Illustration above the heading (live: the question-mark panda head).

image_width.description: Illustration intrinsic width in px. 0 omits it.

image_height.description: Illustration intrinsic height in px. 0 omits it.

code.description: Big status line in the brand gradient, e.g. 404. It is part of the h1.

body.description: Paragraph under the heading. Line breaks are kept.

links.description: Buttons and links, in order. Each: label, url, style (primary: gradient button; secondary: outline button; text: plain link).

background.description: Backdrop image URL (the soft colour wash), drawn cover-sized.
